tooltips.metaCapiEnabled: When enabled, stage changes on Opportunities in this funnel send events to Meta Conversions API.
tooltips.metaCapiDataset: Which Dataset (Pixel) receives events from this funnel. If empty, the Default dataset is used.
tooltips.metaCapiReady: Read-only. True iff this funnel is fully wired: metaCapiEnabled AND a linked, active MetaCapiDataset. Drives whether the OpportunityStage detail layout exposes the Meta Conversions API panel.
